descriptions: PokéDex entries state that it is the brutal result of two separate Pokemon achieving physical fusion.
It possesses a complex neural network of four linked brains, making it smarter than a supercomputer.
When hunting, it pins prey to the ground under its heavy body and chews using a mouth hidden on its stomach.
It is a highly celebrated Steel/Psychic type that serves as the ultimate ace partner to the Hoenn Champion, Steven.
The massive, four-legged metallic powerhouse known as the Iron Leg Pokémon.
In the original Game Boy games, it shares a completely identical audio cry with Rhydon.
It was one of the earliest designs illustrated by Ken Sugimori, appearing on the first capsule monsters sketches.
It requires a Moon Stone to evolve into its final purple, bipedal form.
It is a classic Generation 1 Poison/Ground type known for its high physical attack.
The drill-tailed, spike-covered king known as the Poison Pin Pokémon.
Its PokéDex entry states that when it undergoes Mega Evolution, its massive energy causes its single physical pouch to split open completely.
The mother is filled with intense psychological anxiety because the baby is too small to defend itself.
It is a pure Normal-type creature that carries its young inside a distinct abdominal pouch.
Its competitive footprint is legendary due to its signature multi-striking ability, Parental Bond.
The classic marsupial dinosaur known as the Parent Pokémon.
According to its PokéDex files, its apparent yellow 'eyeballs' are actually fake, non-functional electricity organs.
Its true, functioning eyes are located small and flat directly above its massive belly button.
It is an eccentric, fluid-filled Electric frog that debuted in Generation 9.
It serves as the signature ace partner used by the Paldean Gym Leader and influencer, Iono.
The squishy, bumbling creature officially known as the EleFrog Pokémon.
Its PokéDex files claim that its internal core acts like an active fusion reactor, reaching temperatures over 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
Despite its boiling heat, its fragile volcanic rock shell crumbles instantly if touched.
It is a slow, heavy dual-type Fire/Rock snail that debuted back in Generation 2.
Its character name is a direct, creative combination of magma and the French culinary dish escargot.
The flaming, red-eyed volcanic snail that evolves directly from Slugma.
When it Gigantamaxes, the massive glowing swirl inside its shell mimics a terrifying 36,000-degree whirlpool.
It is a bulky Generation 8 dual-type Water/Rock turtle that patrols coastal shores.
Its base form evolves directly from a small, biting snapping turtle called Chewtle.
It serves as the signature ace powerhouse used by the Galar Gym Leader, Nessa.
The aggressive, heavy-jawed giant officially known as the Bite Pokémon.
This creature is structurally composed of 108 malevolent spirits bound to an ancient stone fissure.
It cannot be found normally in the wild and requires interacting with an Odd Keystone item.
It completely lacked any physical type weaknesses prior to the introduction of Fairy-type.
It enters combat as a glowing, purple ghostly wheel bound to a smiling rock.
The forbidden Ghost/Dark type Pokémon introduced in Sinnoh.
PokéDex entries claim it can run completely silent by dampening its own molecular vibrations.
It requires a highly specific trade mechanic directly involving a Karrablast to trigger evolution.
It strips off its heavy shell armor to maximize its physical ninja speed.
It is a pure Bug-type that bases its design on a swift ninja or motorcyclist.
The shell-less, hyper-fast Shell Out Pokémon introduced in Unova.
Its evolutionary method requires the player to physically hold the console upside down in real life.
It is a deep-sea creature that attacks by manipulating hypnotic lights on its body.
It evolves directly from a small, innocent-looking squid called Inkay.
It boasts a rare Dark/Psychic typing that leaves it completely immune to Psychic moves.
The malicious Overturn Pokémon that resembles an upside-down jellyfish.
According to Alolan PokéDex files, the absolute shock of seeing its true face caused a local scholar to pass away from fright.
It is a dual Ghost/Fairy type that creates a crude disguise using an old market rag.
Its custom battle mechanic completely invalidates the damage from the first attack it sustains.
It spent generations trying to mirror Pikachu to escape its deep loneliness.
The tragic, rag-wearing Alolan doll known as the Disguise Pokémon.
According to ancient Galar lore, its massive metal armor plate is the result of centuries of direct iron mining consumption.
It holds an intense, natural territorial rivalry with the airborne predator Mandibuzz.
It serves as the signature flying taxi system across the entire Galar region map.
It is a heavy Flying/Steel dual-type raven that evolves directly from Corvisquire.
The intimidating, steel-feathered titan known as the Raven Pokémon.
PokéDex lore states that it evolved because its critical anger levels became too severe for its physical body to contain.
It is a highly aggressive Ghost/Fighting dual-type that debuted in the Paldea region.
It breaks standard conventions by evolving from a classic Generation 1 Pokémon when using Rage Fist.
Its shaggy, dark gray fur is physically matted with boiling physical rage.
The furious, broken-shackle warrior that serves as the final evolution of Primeape.
This creature functions as a unique parasitic fungus that has completely taken over an insect host.
The massive mushroom on its back controls and dictates all of the creature's thoughts.
It possesses completely blank, white circular eyes indicating it is a zombie.
It is a classic Generation 1 Bug/Grass type that suffers from a massive 4x weakness to Fire.
The pincered mushroom insect that evolves directly from Paras.
In the Generation 3 games, it required its trainer to max out its beauty stat to evolve.
It serves as a direct, majestic visual counterpart to the aggressive Gyarados.
It is widely celebrated across the Pokémon world as the most beautiful species alive.
It is an elegant, serpentine pure Water-type covered in colorful blue and pink scales.
The majestic Tender Pokémon that evolves directly from the pathetic Feebas.
Its PokéDex entries reveal that humans can become this specific Pokémon, arising directly from wandering graveyard spirits.
It carries a heavy gold or clay mask that explicitly used to be its face when it was a living human.
It is a pure Ghost-type introduced in Unova that frequently looks at its mask and cries.
It can evolve cleanly into Cofagrigus or a regional variant called Runerigus.
The wandering, heartbreaking shadow spirit known as the Spirit Pokémon.
It holds the unique title of being the only Legendary Pokémon with a random 50/50 gender ratio.
It is an ancient volcanic entity composed entirely of Magma and heavy Steel plates.
It resides in the deepest, boiling core of the Stark Mountain crater.
It is a highly distinct Fire/Steel legendary type that resembles a heavy metal turtle.
The massive Lava Dome Pokémon introduced in Generation 4.
This steel tank can completely alter its stance and base stats mid-fight depending on the move used.
It possesses a signature ability called Stance Change that alters its forms.
It utilizes a signature stance-changing mechanic called Blade Forme and Shield Forme.
It enters combat carrying a massive royal shield and a dangerous glowing blade.
The elite Steel/Ghost type royal sword Pokémon native to Kalos.
This creature is structurally the only starter Pokémon to start with a dual typing at stage one in Generation 7.
It utilizes a highly unique signature move called Spirit Shackle to trap enemies.
It evolves from a round, leafy owl into a sleek, hooded archer.
It swaps its flying attribute for a Ghost typing upon reaching its final stage.
The Grass/Ghost type grass starter belonging to the Alola region.
When it Gigantamaxes, the colossal loop of sand around its body contains over one million tons of high-speed grit.
It is a Ground-type serpent introduced in Generation 8 that lives buried in deserts.
It possesses a unique, signature ability called Sand Spit that automatically kicks up a sandstorm when hit.
Its base form evolves directly from a tiny burrowing sand-worm called Silicobra.
The heavy, coiled desert python known as the Sand Snake Pokémon.
Its Paldean PokéDex entry states it dry-cures its prey by spraying salt to completely dehydrate them.
It possesses a highly unique, signature offensive status move called Salt Cure.
It is a blocky, layered rock monster that resembles a mineral-based digital cube.
It is a pure Rock-type that has an evolutionary line consisting of Nacli and Garganacl.
The salt-crusted Generation 9 rock creature known as the Rock Salt Pokémon.
